dedupe_keys.name: ear diario por ree reservatorio equivalente de energia

description: ONS publishes daily stored hydropower energy (EAR) by equivalent energy reservoir. The measure represents generation available from stored water at a plant and at downstream plants in the cascade. Verified storage levels determine the daily estimate; maximum EAR describes full-storage capacity. The dictionary supplies energy amounts in MWmês and relative-storage percentages. ONS identifies energy studies and marginal-operation-cost projection as uses. These indicators support hydrothermal dispatch modelling. Other EAR groupings aggregate the same system and must not be treated as independent observations. Coverage is equivalent energy reservoir groups in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
